'''[[Pagda Gevtes]]' personal [[Walker/Legends|walker]]''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used by the [[Devisors]].

==Characteristics==
Like much of [[Exocron]]'s technology, it was a design that had been obsolete for decades in much of the galaxy. However, despite its appearance, it was armed with a powerful [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]], a type of technology that the Devisors had forbade the populace of the planet to possess.<ref name="TKO" />

==History==
During the [[Liberation of Exocron#Invasion of the Ministry of Technology|Invasion of the Ministry of Technology]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Pagda Gevtes]] used the personal walker to engage [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces attempting to rescue [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]]. Gevtes was temporarily blinded by a [[flash pistol]], and the walker was lured to a stairwell. Gevtes failed to negotiate the stairwell, and the walker rolled down it, crashing at the bottom and trapping the Devisor.
